messages:
Nina: Quick thread 1: need to finalize the onboarding + deprecation playbook for customer-facing models. Key asks from Sales: clear SLA impact, pin windows, and a comms template.

Omar: Propose short, pragmatic gates: run core evals (QA + summarization), perf smoke, and a safety pass. Keep thresholds negotiable per contract.

Eli: For pins: default Hosted=30d, Dedicated=90d, Private=120d. Make pin longer for paid add-on. Also require a "soft-notice" 14 days for non-backwards changes.

Nina: Good. For deprecation: recommend 60d notice for Hosted, 120d for Dedicated/Private, canary opt-in 14d, and compatibility shim if easy.

CS-bot: Created ticket PRO-4459 and attached draft comms: https://go/redwood/notes/PRO-4459-playbook-draft

Omar: I'll draft the minimal checklist and a CI snippet to run the evals automatically. Eli, can you validate infra routing to honor pins?

Eli: Yes, can add routing flag and fallback to previous variant. Will file INF-3301 for rollout window.

Nina: Action items: Omar (checklist + CI), Eli (routing + INF-3301), Nina (comms + legal blurb). Target: PR by EOW.

Omar: ack. Short Q: do we require schema-stability tests? Might save us regressions.

Eli: Recommend simple schema diff unit test in the harness.

Nina: Perfect. I'll loop in CS lead for Customer Y after PR.
